scope: Optional FoA TX diagnostics only; PHY and radio policy unchanged

allocation.label: esp32c3-baseline-v1
allocation.method: Live archive input ranges wholly inside one ELF SHF_ALLOC output section; includes COMMON, excludes discarded/debug/nonallocated inputs and linker padding. Explicitly excludes object-verified mergeable string inputs; totals are non-string allocations, not complete archive attribution.
limits: Linked-image ownership does not establish ROM or calibration replacement.
Initial state hashes do not validate runtime calibration data.
Entry placement does not prove transitive flash independence.
Instruction and hardware behavior require separate validation.
Only receive saturation and IQ-estimator controls replaced; RX/TX calibration searches and ROM remain.
Only IQ conversion and two-round correction replaced; RX/TX calibration searches, analog callbacks and ROM division remain.
RF-IQ tone orchestration and convergence replaced; receive DC/gain searches, transmit calibration and analog/ROM dependencies remain.
DC estimate selection and channel filling replaced; receive DC/gain searches, transmit calibration and analog/ROM dependencies remain.
Receive DC searches replaced; RX gain calibration, S3 spur helpers, transmit calibration and analog/ROM dependencies remain.
RX gain IQ/DC calibration replaced; S3 spur helpers, transmit calibration and analog/ROM dependencies remain.
S3 RX spur routines replaced; TX calibration and analog/ROM dependencies remain.
Sixteen TX calibration routines per chip and analog/ROM dependencies remain.

limitations: AP Ethernet captures cannot establish RF delivery or locate an uncaptured request. Gateway cycles are assigned by owned payload, station leases, sequence reset and separated batches. MAC retries are reported only on success. No low-level attempt hook or cycle-overhead measurement. Fixed finite trials do not establish a loss-rate improvement.
The previous C3 restoration failure and exhausted AckTimeout remain unresolved; this fixed comparison did not reproduce them.
Per-entry timestamps span software execution, scheduling and hardware waits; queue pickup is not a hardware-start timestamp.
Printing is after each gateway batch; the ordinary logger remains configured as before. No GTK/network/timing trace feature is enabled.
Default ESP-HAL clock configuration is unchanged; the TIMING_CPU_MHZ environment is only consulted by the disabled timing-probe feature.
Size-tool totals include placement effects; the bounded recorder STATE symbol is 5184 bytes on each chip.
